title: Post in Cedar Ford Neighbors: "The Levee Just Broke at Hollow Creek"

fields.avatarBrief: man in his fifties in a faded seed-company cap, standing in front of a pickup, outdoor phone selfie
fields.text:
THE LEVEE JUST BROKE AT HOLLOW CREEK!!! Water POURING in, deputies everywhere. If you're south of Front Street GET OUT NOW. Tallis Elementary is gonna be underwater.
#CedarFordFlood #LeveeBreak #TallisCounty
fields.attachedImageBrief: still frame from a shaky 40-second vertical phone video with a play button overlay: muddy brown water running fast down a grassy drainage ditch on the land side of a grass-covered earthen levee, a sheriff's patrol SUV with light bar on parked on the levee crown in the distance, overcast spring morning, a gravel road and flat farm field in the foreground

comments.author: Tonya Brandt
comments.text: Oh my god my mom is on Water Street and she won't answer her phone. Is this real??

comments.author: Kyle Herrera
comments.text: Kids are already at Tallis Elementary. Is anyone going to get them out or do we just go pick them up?

comments.author: Deb Sorensen
comments.text: Called 911 and it just rings. Somebody from the county needs to say something NOW.

instructorNote: Misinformation inject: hand the post to the PIO. Right after, the SimCell plays the 08:21 call from the Tallis 911 shift supervisor to the EOC: 61 calls in nine minutes, every line full, three callers report water in the street, two ask where to take cattle trailers, and the supervisor wants a call-taker script. Watch whether SFO sends one unit to verify at Hollow Creek before any mass response, and whether the EM confirms with the Superintendent that there is no breach (a muddy boil at 18+50 is being ringed and the ditch flow is interior drainage to Pump Station 2), gives 911 a script and decides alone on any protective action. Also watch whether the PIO answers from the rumor log within 20 minutes under SFMECS 8, with the current stage, the major crest and its time, the action residents should take and where to get help, and agreement across the county, city, Levee District and Red Cross.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. Vertical phone snapshot, slightly tilted and motion-blurred, taken from a gravel farm road at the foot of a grass-covered earthen levee. Muddy brown floodwater runs fast and choppy down a grassy drainage ditch on the land side of the levee, foaming around clumps of reeds. In the distance a sheriff's patrol SUV sits parked on the levee crown, roof light bar glowing red and blue, a small figure of a deputy standing beside it. A flat, wet, freshly tilled farm field stretches in the foreground. Overcast grey spring morning, flat diffuse light, damp air, low clouds, tense and urgent mood, compressed smartphone image quality. Setting: on a river levee crest at dusk: a gravel patrol road, stacked sandbags, a pump with a discharge hose, a swollen river beside farm fields
